note: Re-run on 2026-08-17 after the scenario and the api.course_review_projection_exists assertion were tightened. The earlier codex runs are not evidence for this phase: they passed against a scenario that let the agent hand-assemble the observation payload, and against a projection assertion that passed on the not_a_course disposition. Driver is claude-code because the codex account was over quota; both drivers are permitted by phase-integrity.yaml. The observation is produced by piping the harness's recorded PostToolUse payload into the hook the integration installed - the documented fallback for a harness that cannot deliver its own payload to a differently-driven session.
